title: The Mythical Man-Month in the Age of AI
script:
Frederick Brooks wrote in nineteen seventy five that adding workers to a late project makes it later.
That principle defined software development for half a century.
Now generative models and coding assistants mutate that rule entirely.
The constraint shifts from human labor to agent orchestration.
Engineering teams must manage autonomous systems instead of dozens of human developers.
How will your organization adapt to this architectural shift?
